thread.title_full: Man arrested in shooting death of 11th-grade student in Belzoni - NewsBreak

author: Kaitlin Howell
title: Man arrested in shooting death of 11th-grade student in Belzoni - NewsBreak
text:
By Kaitlin Howell ,
11 hours ago BELZONI, Miss. ( WJTV ) - Belzoni police announced a man was arrested in connection to the shooting death of an 11th grade student following a jamboree football game.
According to police, Belzoni officers and Humphreys County deputies conducted a traffic stop on August 25, 2026, involving a vehicle believed to be connection to the shooting death of Jakamryn Price.
Community gathers in Belzoni to address youth gun violence Investigators identified the driver as Jaronski Watson. He was arrested in connection with the homicide. During a search of the vehicle, police said officers located a weapon.
The shooting occurred in the 100 block of 3rd Street on August 21, 2026, down the street from the football stadium shortly after the game concluded. Witnesses inside the stadium reported hearing two distinct single gunshots.
Jaronski Watson (Courtesy: Belzoni PD) Investigators believe Price was not the intended target of the gunfire.
The Mississippi Bureau of Investigation (MBI) is assisting local authorities with the ongoing case. Belzoni police said they expect to make additional arrests.
